title: Python scripts: Prefer 'in' operator to str.find()

notes.body: Is this for consistency?  Is there a performance bump?
It is mostly for readability, but I did read that it should be faster - one person seemed to have benchmarks, but most people just reasoned that there was an extra cost for find() to return index.

I had been running a couple of the scripts through cProfile and noticed that .find() was quite expensive.  I found other changes that made quite a big difference, and would have done this for readability anyway.
